list.title: Amagurisha
list.description: Ibyo koperative yagurishije, abayiguzeho, n'umwenda usigaye kuri byo.
list.caption: Amagurisha yose, hamwe n'inomero yayo, itariki, umuguzi, ikigega, igiteranyo n'umwenda usigaye.
list.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona amagurisha. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
list.totalsCover: Amagurisha yemejwe gusa, ku mapaji yose y'ibi byatoranyijwe. Umushinga ntibarwa.
list.emptyBody: Andika igurisha rya mbere, rigaragare hano nk'umushinga kugeza umuntu aryemeje.
list.emptyFilteredBody: Hitamo undi muguzi, ikindi kigega cyangwa indi gihe, cyangwa ukureho ibyatoranyijwe urebe amagurisha yose.

summary.title: Ibyagurishijwe muri iki gihe
summary.description: Amagurisha yemejwe hagati ya {{from}} na {{to}}. Umushinga ni icyifuzo umuntu yanditse, ni yo mpamvu ntibarwa hano.
summary.chartEmpty: Nta kintu cyagurishijwe muri iki gihe, nta shusho yo kwerekana.
summary.tableCaption: Ibyagurishijwe muri buri gice cy'iki gihe, mu mibare nyayo.
summary.topBuyersEmpty: Nta muguzi ufite igurisha ryemejwe muri iki gihe.
summary.topProductsEmpty: Nta gicuruzwa cyagurishijwe muri iki gihe.

form.newDescription: Igurisha ribikwa nk'umushinga. Nta kintu kiva mu kigega kandi nta mafaranga yandikwa kugeza umuntu aryemeje.
form.editDescription: Imirongo isimburwa n'iyiri hano, sige ahariho ibyo bikigurishwa byose.
form.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona iryo gurisha. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
form.notADraftBody: Igurisha ryemejwe cyangwa ryahagaritswe ntirishobora guhindurwa. Rihagarike hanyuma wandike irindi.
form.buyerPlaceholder: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, umuryango cyangwa nimero ya telefone
form.saleDateHint: Uyu munsi, keretse igurisha ryabaye ku rundi munsi.
form.linesDescription: Umurongo umwe kuri buri gicuruzwa. Umurongo ufite igiciro cya 0 ni uko bitanzwe ubuntu byandikwa.
form.productPlaceholder: Shakisha ukoresheje izina cyangwa kode y'igicuruzwa
form.quantityHintUnit: Mu {{unit}}. Imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze, urugero 400.500.
form.quantityHint: Imibare gusa. Imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze.
form.unitPriceHint: Imyanya ibiri nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze. 0 yandika ibitanzwe ubuntu.
form.overStockWarning: Inyandiko ivuga ko ikigega kifite {{onHand}}, ariko uyu murongo usaba {{asked}}. Umushinga urenze ibiri mu kigega wemewe; ububiko bugenzurwa igihe igurisha ryemezwa.
form.discountHint: Sige ubusa iyo nta kintu cyagabanyijwe. Ntirishobora kurenza imirongo yose hamwe.
form.taxHint: Sige ubusa iyo nta musoro ureba iri gurisha.
form.computedNote: Imibare iri hano ibarwa aha kugira ngo igenzurwe n'ibyemeranywa. Igurisha rihabwa igiciro na seriveri, ari yo ikoreshwa ku nyemezabwishyu no mu bitabo.
form.noteHint: Umurongo umwe ibiro bizakumva n'umwaka utaha, urugero: byatwawe n'ikamyo RAB 123 C.

formErrors.noLines: Ongeraho nibura umurongo umwe. Kugurisha ubusa si igurisha.
formErrors.quantity: Andika ingano irenze zeru, ifite imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze.
formErrors.unitPrice: Andika igiciro gifite imyanya ibiri nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze. 0 yemewe.
formErrors.discount: Andika igabanuka rifite imyanya ibiri nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze.
formErrors.discountTooLarge: Igabanuka riruta ibyo imirongo igeraho, byatuma igurisha riba umubare uri munsi ya zeru. Rigabanye kugeza kuri {{subtotal}} cyangwa munsi yaho.
formErrors.tax: Andika umusoro ufite imyanya ibiri nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze.
formErrors.note: Icyo cyitonderwa kirekire cyane ku biro. Kigabanye.

detail.title: Igurisha {{reference}}
detail.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona iryo gurisha. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
detail.draftNotice: Iri gurisha ni umushinga. Nta kintu cyavuye mu kigega kandi nta mafaranga yanditswe, imirongo iracyashobora guhinduka.
detail.cancelledNotice: Iri gurisha ryahagaritswe. Ibicuruzwa byasubiye mu kigega kandi amafaranga yinjiye yasubijwe inyuma, byombi nk'inyandiko nshya aho kuba isibwa.
detail.linesCaption: Buri murongo w'iri gurisha, hamwe n'igicuruzwa, ingano, igiciro cya kimwe n'icyo umurongo ugeraho.

detail.paymentsEmptyBody: Andika ubwishyu igihe umuguzi yishyuye, bwandikwe mu bitabo icyarimwe.
detail.movementsCaption: Buri gikorwa cy'ububiko iri gurisha ryanditse, hamwe n'inomero, igicuruzwa n'ingano.
detail.movementsEmptyBody: Ibicuruzwa bisohoka igihe igurisha ryemejwe, kandi buri murongo uhabwa igikorwa cyawo.

confirmDialog.title: Emeza iri gurisha
confirmDialog.description: Kwemeza bikura ibicuruzwa mu kigega, byandika igikorwa kuri buri murongo kandi bishyire ikimenyetso ku igurisha. Ntibisubizwa inyuma; igurisha ryemejwe rihagarikwa aho guhindurwa.
confirmDialog.restateOneLine: Umurongo umwe usohoka mu {{warehouse}} kandi {{buyer}} asabwa {{total}}.
confirmDialog.paymentIntro: Kwakira amafaranga ubu ni ibisanzwe ku kigega. Sige ingano ubusa iyo umuguzi azishyura nyuma.
confirmDialog.amountPaidHint: Ntibirenze igiteranyo. Sige ubusa iyo nta mafaranga yatanzwe.
confirmDialog.noPaymentFields: Kwandika amafaranga bisaba ibitabo, inshingano zawe ntibizikubiyemo. Emeza igurisha hano, umufite ibitabo azandike ubwishyu nyuma.
confirmDialog.insufficientBody: Igurisha rikiri umushinga kandi nta kintu cyimutse: nta bicuruzwa byasohotse kandi nta mafaranga yanditswe. Ryongere urisome kugira ngo urebe ingano nk'uko iri ubu, cyangwa ugabanye imirongo.

confirmErrors.amountPaid: Andika ingano ifite imyanya ibiri nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze, cyangwa uyisige ubusa.
confirmErrors.incomeCategory: Hitamo aho aya mafaranga ajya mu bitabo. Ubwishyu bugomba kubivuga.

paymentDialog.title: Andika ubwishyu
paymentDialog.description: Ubwishyu bwandikwa mu bitabo icyarimwe, igurisha n'ibitabo ntibishobora kuvuguruzanya ku byakiriwe.

cancelDialog.title: Guhagarika igurisha {{reference}}?
cancelDialog.consequenceConfirmed: Ibicuruzwa bisubira mu kigega kandi amafaranga yinjiye asubizwa inyuma, byombi nk'inyandiko nshya aho kuba isibwa, amateka agakomeza kuvuga ibyabaye. Igurisha risigara mu nyandiko nk'iryahagaritswe.
cancelDialog.consequenceDraft: Umushinga uvanwa mu mirimo. Nta kintu cyari cyavuye mu kigega kandi nta mafaranga yari yanditswe, nta kintu gisubizwa.
cancelDialog.reasonHint: Birakenewe. Igurisha ryahagaritswe ridasobanurwa ni iryo nta muntu ushobora kugenzura.
cancelDialog.done: {{reference}} ryahagaritswe kandi ibyo ryakoze byasubijwe inyuma.
